verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials for an agent is a fair question for dltHub, which runs agents on managed infrastructure. The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens for an agent. The MCP server's read-only SQL query tool and its pipeline-secrets management are adjacent features, not scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
